The '''Lower Coromon Chain''' was a group of windswept crags that formed part of the [[Coromon Islands]], an island chain located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Fresia/Legends|Fresia]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Incom Corporation/Legends|Incom Corporation]]&mdash;a Fresia-based manufacturing concern&mdash;was taken over by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the new regime used the Lower Coromon Chain to house [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] laborers that worked in the Incom manufacturing plants, which were located an hour's transport journey from the Lower Coromon Chain. The laborers that resided on the islands consisted mainly of [[B'trillan]]s, [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]] and [[Yuzzem]], and they were discouraged from escape attempts by the presence of a stretch of [[gazarant]] feeding grounds within the islands.<ref name="CCW" />
